details.judge_reason: Text is sharp, high-contrast, and easily readable against the wooden background.

product.reason: Shirt pattern, logo, pocket, and construction match reference; only staging (lighting, angle, cropping) differs.

observations.shape: Same short-sleeve button-down shirt shape with chest pocket and button-down collar, consistent proportions in both images.
observations.colour: Same navy/white plaid pattern and material appearance in both images; lighting in ad image is warmer but pattern and colorway match.
observations.logo: Carhartt leather-like patch logo visible on chest pocket in both images, consistent placement and form.
observations.label_text: No readable fine print text visible in either image; nothing garbled or inconsistent.
observations.parts_and_count: Single shirt, one chest pocket, button closures consistent in count and placement across both images.
observations.presence: Actual garment is shown worn by a model in both images, not just packaging.

season_fit.reason: Golden fall foliage, warm low-angle light, and layered workwear with short sleeves match a mild autumn day in Montana.

market_fit.reason: Rustic wooden barn, open fields, and rugged workwear convincingly evoke rural Montana without contradicting the setting.

no_cliche.reason: No landmarks, flags, or forced souvenirs; gloves and plaid shirt function naturally as authentic workwear props.
